cml.actionGoal: Split a factor into places, build each piece, and reassemble the whole for g4m 4div1.
invariants: Splitting a factor never changes the product: every piece of the split multiplies the other factor, and the pieces add back to exactly the same total, which is what makes g4m 4div1 decomposable at all.
misconceptions: Adding only some of the partial products, dropping or inventing a zero when factors carry tens, or letting a remainder reach or exceed the divisor.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: If one partial product were left out, exactly how much of the total would go missing?
